text:
maya: Customer on private VPC reports intermittent 504s from /v1/generate and a sudden billing spike. They pasted two request IDs: req_2026-07-01-abc123 and req_2026-07-01-def456. Collector attempted to produce a debug bundle but upload failed.

kevin: Can you paste the minimal curl they used and the exact collector log tail? we need repro steps + trace ids.

maya: Curl they used (sanitized):
```bash
curl -i -X POST https://private-api.example.com/v1/generate 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED" 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
  -d '{"model":"redwood-3b","prompt":"summarize: ...","max_tokens":512}'
```
Response was 504 after ~12s. They also saw repeated retries from their client (~3x).

maya: Collector log tail (private collector agent v1.4.2):
```
2026-07-01T15:12:03Z INFO start bundle job id=cb-9382
2026-07-01T15:12:05Z WARN redaction: skipping unknown field "session.metadata.extra"
2026-07-01T15:12:06Z ERROR handoff presign failed status=403 url=https://s3.internal.example.com/presign id=cb-9382 err=SignatureDoesNotMatch
2026-07-01T15:12:06Z INFO retry presign attempt=2
2026-07-01T15:12:07Z ERROR upload failed err=403
2026-07-01T15:12:07Z INFO bundle status=failed
```

jon: 403 presign + SignatureDoesNotMatch usually indicates clock skew or wrong signing key / region mismatch. Is this a new KMS key rotation?

maya: Customer says they rotated their S3 credentials a week ago but told us collector credentials come from the private control plane (we didn't rotate on their side).

alice: Two things to check quickly: (1) Collector clock vs S3: ask customer to check `date -u` on the collector host. (2) Confirm collector's signing region/env matches the presign service settings. Also confirm KMS decrypt perms if presign uses a KMS-wrapped token.

kevin: Meanwhile we should get a bundle manually so we can inspect redaction mismatch. Steps for customer to run locally and upload (if they can't get presign to work):
1) SSH to the collector host.
2) Run the local bundle command with debug logging: `collector generate-bundle --id cb-9382 --debug --output /tmp/cb-9382.tar.gz`
3) Run redaction locally to reproduce the warn: `collector redact --input /tmp/cb-9382.tar.gz --rules /etc/collector/redact.yaml --output /tmp/cb-9382-redacted.tar.gz`
4) If presign failing, upload directly to our support S3 endpoint using a temporary signed URL we can provide (we'll generate server-side).

maya: I tried (2) and the redact warning looks like it's related to a nested metadata map we recently added in the app: `session.metadata.extra` contains arrays which the redact rules don't cover, so redaction bails. Need to expand rules to cover nested arrays.

ops-collector-bot: Automated note: created support-case 76543 for cb-9382. Attached attempt logs and collector version.

jon: For the presign 403: can someone ask the infra team to check the presign service's logs for cb-9382 around 2026-07-01T15:12:06Z. Look for the canonical string/region used. If we confirm `SignatureDoesNotMatch`, check the region header and algorithm mismatch.

alice: Also, there was a related billing spike: retries from client caused duplicated requests. Ask customer to enable idempotency or reduce retries until we fix 504 root cause. For immediate mitigation, set a canary rule to route traffic to the previous model version or lower concurrency profile.

kevin: Repro curl we should run from an internal jumpbox (to mirror customer's network):
```bash
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  --data '{"model":"redwood-3b","prompt":"summarize: ...","max_tokens":512}' \
  https://private-api.example.com/v1/generate
```
Capture `x-request-id` and `x-runtime-ms` from response headers. If we get 504, capture tcpdump on port 443 for 15s to see connection resets.

maya: Customer provided two more request-ids in the logs: x-request-id=req_7f2c9, x-request-id=req_7f2d0. I've asked them to run the above curl from their jumpbox and paste headers.

jon: If uploading the bundle manually is needed, we can temporarily enable a one-time support presign that allows `PUT` with our server-side signed policy. I can generate that once infra finds the presign service logs.

alice: For redaction rule fix: add a rule line to match `session.metadata.extra[*]` and scrub emails/ips. Example rule snippet: `- path: session.metadata.extra.* type: mask pattern: email|ip` — test locally before re-running redact.

maya: Customer ran `date -u` and collector host is 2026-07-01T15:11:59Z, presign service logs show 2026-07-01T15:12:06Z — looks fine. Infra found in presign logs that canonical string used region `us-east-2` while collector expects `us-east-1`. That explains SignatureDoesNotMatch.

kevin: OK region mismatch. Likely a config drift on the private control plane. Action items: (A) infra fix presign region to match customer's S3 region or (B) update collector config in their private control plane to `us-east-2`. Which is lower risk?

jon: Option A is safer (fix server-side) so we don't force customer config change. Infra oncall (cc @infra-oncall) to patch presign config and redeploy.

alice: After presign fix, instruct customer to re-run `collector handoff --id cb-9382` and watch for HTTP 200 on presign. If still 403, fallback to manual upload: we'll provide `https://support-upload.internal.redwood/signed/oneoff` PUT URL.

maya: Customer also asked for more details on why 504 happened. I explained that token billing spike likely from retries. We'll request a server-side trace for req_2026-07-01-abc123 to see where request stalled (routing, model warmup, or backend timeouts).

kevin: I'll pull traces for req_2026-07-01-abc123 and req_2026-07-01-def456 and post results here. ETA 30m. Assigning owner: kevin (SRE).

maya: thanks. I'll keep customer updated: ask them to hold off retries and run manual bundle upload if presign persists.

ops-collector-bot: Support-case 76543 updated: presign region mismatch -> infra patching.

alice: Follow-ups: (1) Add nested-array redaction rule to our default redact.yaml and ship a patch to collector v1.4.3. (2) Add a presign-region unit test in CI to catch config drift.

maya: Closing notes to put in case: root cause = presign region mismatch + client retries amplifying transient 504s. Remediation steps documented above.

kevin: posted traces: looks like two backend model workers OOMed and controller returned 504 after 10s. We'll recommend model version rollback or capacity bump while infra patches.

maya: I'll update the customer and schedule a follow-up once infra confirms presign fix and we get the redacted bundle. :thumbsup:
